answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 23389 Country: India Title: Pls advice me can i keep my sons name as: Arshaan (persian name), Arhaan, Arhaam and arham. Are these name islamically valid? Question: Pls advice me can i keep my sons name as: Arshaan (persian name), Arhaan, Arhaam and arham. Are these name islamically valid? Answer ID: 23389 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1162/951/B=1431) These names are not right; instead you should name Raihan, Safwan, Affan, Inam, Zishan, Ikram. These are good and desirable names, and they are on the pattern of those names you mentioned. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
